description: This file defines interfaces related to handling HTTP Range requests as specified in RFC 7233. It includes function declarations for configuring and processing HTTP Range requests in the lighttpd server.

methods.name: http_range_config_allow_http10
methods.description: Sets whether to allow HTTP/1.0 range requests based on the provided flag.

methods.name: http_range_rfc7233
methods.description: Processes an HTTP request to handle Range headers according to RFC 7233.
